6. **Taxable Income** = $311,510 - $3,000 - $2,000 = $306,510

7. **Tax** (§1(c)(v)): $79,772 + 39.6% × ($306,510 - $250,000) = $79,772 + 39.6% × $56,510 = $79,772 + $22,377.96 = $102,149.96
